versions.changelog: Replace misleading static business titles in bundled template/spec with neutral placeholders and hard rules so subsection titles must come from the current node's real BP goals.

Switch BP report evidence chain to reportId-based detail fetch; use work-report detail APIs for content, replies, and node opinions; add direct report links; fix month attribution to report_time; finalize fine-grained KR/action cards and review queue.
Add black-light manual-review rule: AI can judge black light only, while subtype selection and required follow-up answers must be confirmed by the user.
Fix report pagination, add raw-hit vs adopted counts, and collapse bulk notification evidence.
Add adopted work-report count summary to section 1 and source inventory.
Bundle default monthly template and rename fill specification to a generic organization example.
Add Chinese business description and Chinese design-solution documents, and wire both references into SKILL.md for business-facing and architecture-facing guidance.

Update evidence model to favor direct report references over local JSON snapshots, add action-layer evidence handling, improve first-turn behavior, unify traffic-light judgment, and refine user-facing report rendering with BP names instead of raw IDs.
Initial alpha release: BP-based monthly report drafting with evidence prioritization, traffic lights, rolling baseline, and artifact preservation.
